name: Knowt
summary: AI study platform with flashcards, lecture summaries, practice tests and AP exam prep.
description: Knowt offers AI study tools: flashcards with learn mode, lecture recording and summarisation into notes and tests, voice tutoring, and AP exam preparation. It positions itself as a free alternative to Quizlet. The Basic plan is free with unlimited file creation; Ultra costs $12.99 per month billed annually ($149.99 upfront) with a three-day trial. Separate plans are offered for students and teachers.

howToUse.title: Open Knowt
howToUse.description: Open Knowt and choose Continue on the Website, or download the app.

howToUse.title: Study flashcards and record a lecture
howToUse.description: Create flashcards and study them in learn mode. Record a lecture and let Knowt turn that recording into notes and tests through summarisation.

howToUse.title: Use voice tutoring and AP preparation
howToUse.description: Use voice tutoring so you are quizzed on your materials, and open the AP exam preparation for practice and mock exams.

howToUse.title: Start on Basic or try Ultra
howToUse.description: Begin on Basic, which costs nothing and allows unlimited file creation. Ultra is $12.99 each month when billed annually, or $149.99 upfront, and includes a three-day trial. Students and teachers have separate plans. Knowt is offered as a free alternative to Quizlet.
